verdict.rationale: Docs confirm invoice lifecycle management, credit invoices as separate compliant records with audit trails, and post-issuance edits (notes, PO numbers, terms) that resemble memos, but there is no evidence of sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, receipt generation, or automatic customer delivery of these documents. missing for 10: sequential numbering guarantee, custom fields on invoices/receipts, receipt generation, automated delivery to customers.
